stable.label: native-cpp-webgpu-volume-ci-pass
stable.note: The prior active C++/WebAssembly material kernel and state-derived WebGPU volume renderer are CI-proven. This momentum/pressure increment is not promoted until branch CI passes; browser and iPhone execution remain unverified.

active_experience.runtime: from-scratch C++ compiled to WebAssembly owns material and water momentum/pressure-proxy state; a JavaScript Worker transfers packed 3D state to a from-scratch WebGPU volume ray marcher
render_coupling: 3D solid/water density derive from native material occupancy
surface normals derive from native field gradients
sand wetness and water sediment feed material appearance
approximations: water remains one occupancy quantum per voxel rather than a continuous mass fraction
pressure is a local discrete proxy, not a Poisson-projected incompressible pressure solve
momentum is clamped signed cell-space state, not SI-unit velocity
no native articulated creatures or learning/evolution yet

tests: water count conserved under momentum transport
pressure state nonzero in water body
water momentum becomes nonzero under gravity/pressure update
explicit positive-x impulse produces positive center-of-mass shift

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching is presentation over native 3D state; time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from native density gradient and turbidity from native sediment.

active_objective: Promote the bounded native water momentum/pressure-proxy increment only after independent GitHub-hosted CI and keep renderer truth tied to simulation state.
next_gate: Compile and run native C++ tests in GitHub Actions, verify committed WASM model v2 boots, preserve Stable vs Lab fail-closed isolation, then merge only if green.
next_scientific_blocker: Replace the local pressure proxy with a mass-fraction/velocity formulation and a discrete divergence/pressure projection or other conservation-controlled incompressibility solve before any CFD claim.
invariants: do not call momentum proxy CFD
Stable vs Lab isolation remains fail-closed
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
